set.body: Acceptance criteria: detected events retain sufficient source support to recompute derived summaries; dispersion has units and a named method; nonlinear or unit-changing warps recompute summaries from warped support or return an explicit unavailable or approximate result with provenance; no pixel dispersion is silently re-labelled as degrees; sample counts, origins, and support remain traceable; round-trip and unit-changing fixtures reject preservation of stale dispersion.
set.title: Make event transformations source-reconstructable
